author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert + RC-avg(eval only) (scalar gate, BiGRU=160) — seed=42
abstract: Eval-only reverse-complement averaging (no RC during training) on the best dual-expert config to retain invariance benefits without training noise. Tests impact on PRS/Modif while keeping APA/CRI gains.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from dual_expert_pool_gru_weighted import build_network as build_base, create_optimizer as make_optimizer
from rc_wrapper import RCWrapper

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 256,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.10,
        'aggregator': 'mean_lse_mix',
        'tau': 0.25,
        'length_normalize_lse': True,
        'learn_tau': False,
        'gru_dim': 160,
        'fusion': 'scalar_gate',
        'post_norm': True,
        'rc_train_p': 0.0,     # eval-only
        'rc_eval_avg': True,
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    base = build_base(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)
    return RCWrapper(base, rc_train_p=hparams.get('rc_train_p', 0.0), rc_eval_avg=hparams.get('rc_eval_avg', True))

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return make_optimizer(learning_rate)

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    ds = trial_data.get('dataset'); vm = trial_data.get('val_metric')
    print(f"[Complete] {ds} val_metric={vm}")
